# Ocean Seven Seafood Trading Company (شركة أوشن سيفن سيفود تريدينغ)

> Ocean Seven Seafood Trading Company supplies fresh Red Sea catch, imported frozen seafood and ready-to-cook products to hotels, restaurants, retailers and wholesalers across Saudi Arabia. Request a price list.

## Facts
- Legal name: Ocean Seven Seafood Trading Company
- Address: Building 6686, Khalid Ibn Al Waleed St., Ash Sharafiyah District, Unit 2661, Jeddah 23216, Saudi Arabia
- Saudi National Address short code: JBSA6686
- Email: info@oceanseven.sa
- Product programmes: Local catch, Imported, Value added
- Cold chain: chilled 0–4 °C; frozen −18 °C or colder
- Customers: Hotels & restaurants; Supermarkets & fish retailers; Caterers & institutions; Wholesalers & distributors
- Pricing: market-based; current price list on request
- Websites: https://salahu01.github.io/ocean-seven/ (English), https://salahu01.github.io/ocean-seven/ar/ (Arabic / العربية)

## Range
- Red Sea fresh catch (صيد البحر الأحمر الطازج) — Local catch; form: Whole · Gutted; state: Chilled
- Salmon steaks (شرائح السلمون) — Imported; form: Steak · Fillet; state: Frozen
- Peeled shrimp (روبيان مقشر) — Imported; form: PD · PUD · HLSO; state: Frozen
- Mussels (بلح البحر) — Imported; form: Whole · Half-shell; state: Frozen
- Oysters (محار) — Imported; form: Half-shell; state: Frozen
- Frozen fish blocks (قوالب سمك مجمد) — Imported; form: Block · IQF; state: Frozen
- Breaded calamari rings (حلقات كاليماري مقرمشة) — Value added; form: Breaded rings; state: Frozen
- Breaded fish fillet (فيليه سمك مغطى بالبقسماط) — Value added; form: Breaded · Formed; state: Frozen
- Catering platters (أطباق مأكولات بحرية للضيافة) — Value added; form: Mixed · Event-ready; state: Chilled / Frozen

## Cold chain
1. Source — Local boats on the Red Sea and vetted producers abroad. Every lot is traceable to where it came from. (Iced at landing)
2. Inspect — Eyes, gills, smell and core temperature are checked on arrival. Anything that fails goes back. (Core ≤ 4 °C)
3. Chill or freeze — Fresh product stays on ice. Imported product arrives frozen and is never allowed to thaw. (0 – 4 °C / −18 °C)
4. Store — Held in temperature-controlled storage in Jeddah, close to the Islamic Port, first in, first out. (Logged daily)
5. Deliver — Refrigerated delivery to your kitchen, store or warehouse, at the temperature it was stored at. (Door at 0 – 4 °C / −18 °C)

## Frequently asked questions
### What is Ocean Seven?
Ocean Seven Seafood Trading Company (شركة أوشن سيفن سيفود تريدينغ) is a seafood wholesaler based in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. We source fresh Red Sea fish, import frozen seafood and supply ready-to-cook seafood products to food businesses across the Kingdom.

### Where are you located?
Building 6686, Khalid Ibn Al Waleed Street, Ash Sharafiyah District, Jeddah 23216. Our Saudi National Address short code is JBSA6686.

### Who do you supply?
Hotels, restaurants and cafés; supermarkets and fish retailers; caterers and institutional kitchens; and wholesalers and distributors.

### How do I get a price list?
Use the request form or email info@oceanseven.sa with your business type, city and what you need. Seafood prices move with the market, so we reply with current prices and availability rather than publishing a fixed list.

### Can you source something you don’t list?
Yes. The range above is our regular programme. Tell us the species, cut, size grade, pack format and expected volume and we will source to order.

### What temperatures do you keep seafood at?
Chilled seafood is held between 0 °C and 4 °C. Frozen seafood is stored and transported at −18 °C or colder, from intake to delivery.
